title: 21.34. Hetuduka, Atītārammaṇattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahetuṁ naatītārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca hetu atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ naanāgatārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā hetu anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ napaccuppannārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca hetu paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
